scripts.build: vp run --no-cache pulse-link-overdrive#build && vp run --no-cache tumbledrum#build && vp run --no-cache hub#build && vp exec node tooling/assemble-site.mjs && vp run artifact:verify
scripts.preview: vp run artifact:verify && vp preview --config tooling/preview.vite.config.mjs
scripts.e2e:install: vp exec playwright install chromium && vp run tumbledrum#browser:install && vp run crown-breaker#browser:install
scripts.e2e: vp run build && vp exec playwright test
scripts.e2e:release: vp run build && vp exec playwright test --config playwright.release.config.ts
scripts.release:tumbledrum: vp run ready && vp run e2e && vp run e2e:lab && vp run e2e:release && vp run deploy:dry-run
scripts.ready: vp run tooling:test && vp check && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 1 test && vp run build
scripts.deploy:dry-run: vp run build && vp exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
